name: Video Importer
description: Turns GIFs, images and frame folders into animated pixel art in the level editor.

placement.name: Placement
placement.description: Background puts the video behind normal gameplay. Movie puts it in front, for levels built around the video.

grid-width.name: Grid width
grid-width.description: How many blocks wide the video is. The height follows the shape of the video. Each block uses one color channel.

fps.name: Frames per second
fps.description: Playback speed. Lower values mean fewer triggers.

video-width.name: Video width
video-width.description: Width of the video in level units. A block is 30 units wide.

center-x.name: Center X
center-x.description: Where the middle of the video goes, measured from the start of the level.

center-y.name: Center Y
center-y.description: Height of the middle of the video.

color-levels.name: Color levels
color-levels.description: Shades per color channel. Lower values give fewer color changes and a rougher look.

change-threshold.name: Change threshold
change-threshold.description: A block only changes color when it differs from what it shows by more than this. Higher values mean fewer triggers.

max-frames.name: Maximum frames
max-frames.description: Longer clips are cut off at this many frames.

first-channel.name: First color channel
first-channel.description: The video uses one channel per block, counting up from here. Pick a range your level does not use.

first-group.name: First group
first-group.description: The video uses a run of groups starting here, one per frame plus three. Pick a range your level does not use.

block-id.name: Block object ID
block-id.description: Object used for each pixel. It should be a plain square without an outline.
